dct_description_sm:
NOTES ON METADATA

These data were collected in four catchments areas. The metadata is organized according to catchment. Where possible, the metadata corresponding to each catchment is noted with the abbreviated catchment name.

  • CCW: Sub-catchment of the Catfish Creek Watershed
  • UP1: IISD-ELA Lake 658 UP1 Catchment
  • HRM: Hermine Catchment
  • MRC: Mahurangi River Catchment

NOTES ON DATA

Data authors/producers for the four watersheds were:

  • CCW: Cody Ross, Department of Geological Sciences, University of Manitoba; Genevieve Ali, School of Environmental Sciences, University of Guelph
  • UP1: Claire Oswald, Department of Geography, Ryerson University; International Institute for Sustainable Development Experimental Lakes Area
  • HRM: Francois Courchesne, Département de géographie, Université de Montréal; Genevieve Ali, School of Environmental Sciences, University of Guelph
  • MRC: The New Zealand National Institute of Water and Atmospheric Research

NOTES ON BROWSING:

Click on the "Tree" view to identify folder structure and related files.

This data includes catchment discharge and meteorological data, which has multiple applications. In "Evaluating the ubiquity of thresholds in rainfall-runoff response across contrasting environments" this data was used to assess nonlinearities in rainfall-runoff relationships.
